genericProblem: A recorded Dexter/Claude acceptance can leave every prerequisite artifact in an older draft state, causing a later fail-closed manifest to contradict the actual authorization or tempting an implementation to ignore the artifact state.
rootCauseClass: Acceptance was communicated after the interaction documents were written, but the acceptance state was not reconciled across their finite prerequisite set.
finiteDenominator: P6 interaction preparation and re-freeze design
searchedSurfaces: P6 preparation status and re-freeze procedure
counterexamples: Claude GO alone does not authorize implementation; every artifact continues to state implementationAuthority=false.
A future bounded Dexter edit would require the affected IA to return to a draft/re-review state; acceptance is not a permanent implementation authorization.

findings.evidence: Dexter explicitly declared the interaction design GO and directed entry to implementation-facing detail design and planning, while all six prerequisite artifacts still declared UNSET/draft acceptance state.
